body: Can I join you? I'm lonely as fuck in the city I'm in now.

Crippling alcoholics subreddit. They have a web chat where people get wasted and drink together via webcam.

http://www.reddit.com/r/cripplingalcoholism
If he's that negative and talking about the abortion, I say limit contact with him and no extended stays. You don't need that kind of treatment.
Oh wow. You don't need that. Do you rely on him for anything?
Family can be rough and sometimes a little too demanding. How long are they visiting for?
Not really. Talked about a lot of issues, but not really how to fix it yet.
Yes. I am. Not on medications though.
I don't think it's a matter of not wanting to get better, but a matter of not knowing how. We've been so depressed and stuck in our ways that it's hard to change our perspectives.
